exposure: obstetric history (prior live birth, previous preterm child)
cohort: The study included 222 women with singleton pregnancies who experienced unknown cause PMPC and 151 women with no complications, all of whom required a thrombophilia study.
finding: Antithrombotic drugs (ASA and LMWH) were found to be protective factors in PMPC prevention, although thrombophilia was not conclusively related to PMPC.
